verdict.rationale: ClickHouse documents its own export paths: backups can be exported to the user's own cloud account, and query responses can be returned in a chosen output format via the X-ClickHouse-Format header / output_format setting. Its data-lake positioning also claims access 'without lock in'. However, the evidence never names specific open formats (e.g. CSV or Parquet) or describes a complete, all-data export for leaving the service. Missing for 10: explicit list of open export formats, documented full-account/all-data export or offboarding workflow, open format of exported backups, independent corroboration of migrating out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
